title: Organic Chemistry: Chapter Introduction
subject: Chemistry
chapter: Organic Chemistry – Some Basic Principles and Techniques
objective: Paracetamol, plastic, cotton and DNA share one element: carbon. Why carbon forms millions of compounds, and what this chapter teaches.

tf.explain: It is a biomolecule built on carbon skeletons.

num.q: How many C–H bonds are in propane, C₃H₈?
steps: Each H forms one bond with carbon

steps: n carbons in a chain have n − 1 C–C bonds

short.q: Give two reasons why carbon forms so many compounds.
short.solution: Tetravalency: 4 bonds per atom. Catenation: strong C–C bonds give chains and rings.
